Spring, eventful and bright
The desk staff are ready
Travel Notes for Pets in Spring

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping plans calm, clear, and steady as spring traffic grows. <<FACT F042>> Staff should confirm carrier fit, label each travel case clearly, and review feeding notes before handoff. Cabin teams continue to watch animals in flight, and they will report any concern early so the ground team can respond without delay.

For routes that include Cloudrest, use <<FACT F046>> and remind travelers to keep documents easy to reach at check-in. If a pet seems unsettled, slow the process, speak in a quiet voice, and give the traveler simple next steps. The aim is safe movement, careful handling, and a smoother journey for every animal in our care.
